recommendations.title: Add download retry logic guidance
recommendations.problem: Reliability 2.1 scored 11/12; no explicit retry strategy for network failures during long downloads. References skip-if-present but not resume-from-partial.

recommendations.fix: Add to troubleshooting or reference/downloads.md: complexa download has skip-if-present logic (safe to re-run same flag), but partial files need manual cleanup. Document: rm incomplete .ckpt before retry, or use --force flag if added.
